itemMall.$comment: Item Mall (Silk cash shop) catalog. Hand-editable — survives pnpm gen:sro. Prices are WHOLE Silk (1 Silk = 100 wallet units); the server debits the ACCOUNT wallet, so any character on the account can buy. Items must exist in items.json and must not be gear (mall grants don't roll instance stats). Avatar pieces follow retail silk-era tiers (dress > hat > accessory, wing dresses premium); grab pets keep their old gold-shop ordering (rabbit < cat < monkey < goldpig).

enhance.$comment: Alchemy + durability tunables (M22). successByPlus keyed by the item's CURRENT plus — values follow the community-reversed vSRO rates (retail rates were hardcoded in Joymax's server binary, never in data files). failurePolicy 'reset' = authentic old-SRO: a failed fuse drops the item back to +0 (elixir always consumed). Lucky Powder multiplies the chance by powderBonusMult (capped at 100%) and its tier must match the gear's degree. Durability drops probabilistically (weapon per attack/skill strike, armor per hit taken, shield per block); at 0 the piece contributes no stats until repaired. The wear chances are EXPLICIT NON-PARITY POLICY: the original wear trigger/probability is [UNRESOLVED] in .decompilation/silkroad-item-durability-calculation.md §8 — tuned 2026-08 (BR-0052) so a botting caster drains a d8 weapon in hours, not minutes. Repair gold uses the client-proven per-item CostRepair/CostRevive quote (same doc §6), not a flat per-point price.

magicStones.$comment: HAND-OWNED (survives pnpm gen:sro). Blue-option magic stones: crafted by the enchanter profession from wood+stone materials, applied to same-degree gear via the Alchemy window. Application mechanics follow .decompilation/silkroad-item-blue-options-and-magic-stones.md (9-line cap, same-family replace, retail 50% roll, assimilation {10,20,30}); acquisition (crafting) is ours. Item defs are expanded at load: one magicstone_<effect>_<degree> per family x degree 1-8.

craft.$comment: Recipes consume BOTH collector lines at tierByDegree; counters additionally burn one tier-5 pinch of counterT5Resource. Craft always succeeds (risk lives at application) and grants xpByDegree enchanter XP.

premium.$comment: Premium (account-bound subscription) catalog. Hand-editable — survives pnpm gen:sro. Premium is NOT an item (it activates instantly on purchase, shared across all characters on the account), so it lives here, not in item-mall.json. priceJade is WHOLE Silk (1 Silk = 100 wallet units); durationDays is the length added per purchase. xpSpBonusPct is the additive % boost to XP and SP from monster kills. borderColor/nameColor drive the tier-colored bar border and name tag.
